description: MainActivity class for an Android wearable quiz app, managing questions, user interactions, and communication with a paired device via GoogleApiClient and Wearable Data and Message APIs.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Activity managing the quiz questions, user interface, and communication with wearable device.

classes.name: Question
classes.description: Represents a quiz question with methods for JSON parsing and DataItem creation, and comparable by question index.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI components, GoogleApiClient, and data structures.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Connects GoogleApiClient if not already connected.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Removes listeners, sends quiz end message, and clears quiz status.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Adds Data and Message listeners to GoogleApiClient.

methods.name: onConnectionSuspended
methods.description: Handles suspension of GoogleApiClient connection (no action).

methods.name: onConnectionFailed
methods.description: Logs connection failure.

methods.name: onMessageReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, specifically reset quiz command.

methods.name: Question
methods.description: Inner class representing a quiz question with JSON parsing and DataItem conversion.

methods.name: readQuizFromFile
methods.description: Loads questions from JSON file and adds them to the quiz.

methods.name: addQuestion
methods.description: Creates a new question from user input and adds it to the quiz.

methods.name: addQuestionDataItem
methods.description: Adds question to wearable stream or enqueues if a question is already asked.

methods.name: setNewQuestionStatus
methods.description: Displays the status of a new question in the UI.

methods.name: onDataChanged
methods.description: Handles data change events from wearable, updating question statuses.

methods.name: updateQuestionStatus
methods.description: Updates UI for a answered question, marking correct/incorrect.

methods.name: markQuestionLeftBlank
methods.description: Marks a question as left blank if its notification is deleted.

methods.name: askNextQuestionIfExists
methods.description: Asks next question or ends quiz if none left.

methods.name: sendMessageToWearable
methods.description: Sends message to connected wearable nodes.

methods.name: resetQuiz
methods.description: Resets quiz state and data items, preparing for a new quiz.

methods.name: resetDataItems
methods.description: Resets data items to default state.

methods.name: ResetDataItemCallback
methods.description: Callback to reset individual data items.

methods.name: newQuiz
methods.description: Starts a new quiz, deleting existing data items.

methods.name: clearQuizStatus
methods.description: Clears UI question statuses and resets counters.

methods.name: deleteDataItems
methods.description: Deletes specified data items from wearable.

methods.name: setHasQuestionBeenAsked
methods.description: Enables/disables question asking based on quiz state.
